description: This file contains unit tests for the CanvasActionTrust class, specifically testing the isTrustedCanvasActionUrl method for various URL trust scenarios.

classes.name: CanvasActionTrustTest
classes.description: A test class that verifies the behavior of URL trust validation methods in CanvasActionTrust.

methods.name: acceptsBundledScaffoldAsset
methods.description: Tests that a specific scaffold asset URL is recognized as trusted.

methods.name: acceptsTrustedA2uiPageOnAdvertisedCanvasHost
methods.description: Verifies that a known trusted URL with specific host and path is accepted.

methods.name: rejectsDifferentOriginEvenIfPathMatches
methods.description: Ensures URLs with different origins but matching paths are rejected.

methods.name: rejectsUntrustedCanvasPagePathOnTrustedOrigin
methods.description: Checks that URLs with untrusted paths on a trusted origin are rejected.

methods.name: acceptsFragmentOnlyDifferenceForTrustedA2uiPage
methods.description: Verifies that URL differences only in fragments are accepted when origin and path are trusted.

methods.name: rejectsQueryMismatchOnTrustedOriginAndPath
methods.description: Ensures URLs with mismatched query parameters are rejected despite matching origin and path.

methods.name: rejectsDescendantPathUnderTrustedA2uiRoot
methods.description: Checks that URLs extending beyond the trusted path are rejected.
